name: clo-system
description: Course Monitoring and Assessment System for Course Learning Outcomes (CLO System)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c blue,green "npm run dev -w app/client" "npm run dev -w app/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w app/client && npm run build -w app/server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w app/client && npm run lint -w app/server
